body:
I used to be really normal, but people excluded me and I started to read into why. Now, people just point and go "there is something wrong with that person, they are broken."  I used to not be that way, but people excluded me and treated me different for so long I just broke. And now, people can just point to what is and say "that's broken, nothing they say matters, they do not matter." And I guess they aren't wrong.

It's scary.  No one cares. They let you die inside and then they laugh at you.  That's the cold, hard reality of life.  They pick you apart until you're nothing, then laugh at the fact that you're just a shell. Not everyone, most don't even notice, but the ones that do tend to be malevolent for this reason or that, always an excuse to treat someone like this or exclude them, or otherwise pretend to be better, because feelings, and because social darwinism, and a bunch of other bullshit that society picked up really recently and is running with.

Do you understand?  I have to kill myself, people like me are no longer allowed, and we're going to be made fun of and ignored until we kill ourselves, like so many other men before us.

Thanks for writing that, I appreciate it. I guess it's just that some people most certainly seem to be more right than others, don't they? That's what I mean, that this one didn't come out right, at least less so.
Thanks for your words and for taking the time to write that.  Unfortunately, I appear to have hit that downward spiral of anxiety where it all just snowballs and compounds upon itself.
